chapters.name: primitives
chapters.title: Primitives
chapters.summary: The smallest parts. Most are gpui itself; Ely adds the rest.

chapters.name: typography
chapters.title: Typography
chapters.summary: Inter for words, tabular figures for numbers, one ink for everything.

chapters.name: layout
chapters.title: Layout
chapters.summary: Stacks, grids, splits, docks. Structure that stays out of the way.

chapters.name: shell
chapters.title: Window & Shell
chapters.summary: Title bars, rails, tabs, and the windows around an app.

chapters.name: buttons
chapters.title: Buttons & Actions
chapters.summary: Seven variants, three sizes, one focus ring, and the verbs around them.

chapters.name: forms
chapters.title: Forms
chapters.summary: Text, choices, dates, colors, files: every way to say what you mean.

chapters.name: navigation
chapters.title: Navigation
chapters.summary: Tabs, paths, places and palettes: where you are, and the ways out.

chapters.name: menus
chapters.title: Menus
chapters.summary: Rows of actions that open from a button, a right click or an arrow, and nest.

chapters.name: overlays
chapters.title: Overlays
chapters.summary: Panels over the page: anchored to a control, over a scrim, or over everything.

chapters.name: feedback
chapters.title: Feedback
chapters.summary: What the app tells you: toasts, notifications, alerts and the states a view can be in.

chapters.name: motion
chapters.title: Loading & Motion
chapters.summary: Waiting, shown honestly, and the motion everything else moves with.

chapters.name: data
chapters.title: Data Display
chapters.summary: People, numbers and records, shown plainly.

chapters.name: lists
chapters.title: Lists & Trees
chapters.summary: Rows to read, pick, reorder and swipe; lists long enough to need care.

chapters.name: tables
chapters.title: Tables
chapters.summary: Rows and columns that sort, filter, page and select, and stay quick at a hundred thousand rows.

chapters.name: charts
chapters.title: Charts
chapters.summary: Lines, bars, parts of a whole, spreads, flows and schedules on quiet axes, with legends, tooltips, zoom and export.

chapters.name: finance
chapters.title: Finance
chapters.summary: Market charts with the studies traders read, books, quotes, order entry and portfolios.

chapters.name: editor
chapters.title: Editor
chapters.summary: A code editor with the gutter, folds and cursors it needs, the help a language server gives, search, the panels around it and its status row.

chapters.name: terminal
chapters.title: Terminal
chapters.summary: A real shell drawn cell by cell, with tabs, splits, find and links; command blocks and history; colored output, logs and processes.

chapters.name: git
chapters.title: Git
chapters.summary: Diffs and merges, changes and commits, the commit graph, branches, blame and review.

chapters.name: debug
chapters.title: Debug
chapters.summary: A paused program: its breakpoints, stack, threads and values, memory and machine code; profiles and network.

chapters.name: documents
chapters.title: Documents
chapters.summary: Markdown written and read, blocks like a notebook's, and a knowledge base around them.

chapters.name: collab
chapters.title: Collaboration
chapters.summary: People in the same document: who is here and where, comments and reactions, suggested changes, and sharing.

chapters.name: chat
chapters.title: AI Chat
chapters.summary: A conversation with an assistant: messages that stream in, code and media inside them, and what can be done with each.

chapters.name: agent
chapters.title: Agent
chapters.summary: An assistant at work: the tools it calls, what it asks before it acts, how far it has come, what it would change, what it sees and what it makes.

chapters.name: generative
chapters.title: Generative
chapters.summary: Making pictures, sound and video with a model: the prompt and its settings, the queue and what comes back, the canvas, the models behind them, and the data and prompts they work from.

chapters.name: media
chapters.title: Media
chapters.summary: Pictures, video and sound: looking closely, cropping and marking up, playing, and the controls and devices around them.

chapters.name: files
chapters.title: Files
chapters.summary: Files and folders: their icons, rows and tiles, and the listings, searches and transfers around them.

chapters.name: messaging
chapters.title: Messaging
chapters.summary: Channels and people: the lists and heads of chats, the messages in them, the people behind them, and calls.

chapters.name: mail
chapters.title: Mail
chapters.summary: Mailboxes and the messages in them: reading, writing, sorting and putting off.

chapters.name: calendar
chapters.title: Calendar
chapters.summary: Days, weeks, months and years, and what happens in them.

chapters.name: project
chapters.title: Project
chapters.summary: Tasks and issues, who has them, where they stand, and when they are due.

chapters.name: canvas
chapters.title: Canvas & Design
chapters.summary: An endless plane to lay work on, the tools and panels around it, and graphs of nodes.

chapters.name: devtools
chapters.title: DB & Dev Tools
chapters.summary: Connections, schemas and queries, data to read, requests to send, and the machines that run them.

chapters.name: dashboard
chapters.title: Dashboard & Monitoring
chapters.summary: Widgets on a grid you arrange, what is firing and what is up, and the stream of what happens.

chapters.name: settings
chapters.title: Settings
chapters.summary: A settings window: its sections, a search over them, and the controls each one holds.

chapters.name: account
chapters.title: Account
chapters.summary: Signing in and up, a link by email, a second factor, and the account once inside.

chapters.name: onboarding
chapters.title: Onboarding & Help
chapters.summary: A first run in steps, what is new called out, first things to do, and help where it is needed.

chapters.name: interaction
chapters.title: Interaction
chapters.summary: Drag and drop, resizing and turning, band selection, presses and gestures, keys, scrolling and focus.

chapters.name: theme
chapters.title: Theme
chapters.summary: Tokens every component reads. Light and dark share one grammar.

chapters.name: i18n
chapters.title: i18n & a11y
chapters.summary: Messages, numbers and dates in the reader's locale. A right-to-left locale mirrors its stacks.

chapters.name: maps
chapters.title: Maps
chapters.summary: Tiles the host supplies, pins with a popup, a picker's crosshair, routes, GeoJSON, heat, clusters and choropleths. The land is Natural Earth's.

chapters.name: misc
chapters.title: Misc
chapters.summary: Small tools that stand alone: clocks, a stopwatch, a calculator, a unit converter, a QR code scanner, a captcha, a poll, a survey, a quiz, flashcards, licenses, terms, a cookie banner, data out and in, and web views.

chapters.name: tooling
chapters.title: Library Tooling
chapters.summary: Tools for building with the library: this gallery, a playground that edits a component live, tools that inspect a running window, its boxes, frames, renders and input, and catalogs of its tokens, icons and contrast.

chapters.name: rendering
chapters.title: Rendering
chapters.summary: Pixels the host draws at the box's size in device pixels, drawn again for a new size or content.

components.name: system_notification
components.description: prove: on macOS `cx.show_system_notification` posts only from an app bundle; unbundled, as `cargo run` starts it, gpui logs and drops the call, so Ely must check the bundle identifier and fail loud. A bundled gallery must post one and hand its response to the owner through `on_system_notification_response`

components.name: gesture
components.description: prove: wheel zoom through `layout::Viewport`, two-finger swipe through `lists::SwipeableListItem`; pinch is not yet shown: gpui hands a trackpad magnify to `on_pinch` as a `PinchEvent`, and `layout::Viewport` must zoom about the pointer on one

components.name: key_chord
components.description: native multi-keystroke bindings; `window.pending_input_keystrokes()` shows the first stroke

components.name: r_t_llayout
components.description: proven: `Direction::row` mirrors a stack and `Direction::align` sets its text's side; a right-to-left line stays one `Ellipsis`, since gpui wraps glyphs in drawn order; Ely's other components stay left to right

components.name: color_blind_safe_palette
components.description: ColorBlindSafe Palette component in i18n & a11y

components.name: q_r_code_scanner
components.description: proven: `rqrr` 0.11 reads the host's frames off the main thread → `misc::QrCodeScanner`, a camera's view with a square to aim at; each code goes to the owner once

components.name: export_dialog
components.description: PDF, PNG, CSV, JSON → `misc::ExportDialog`: the owner's formats as cards, and Export hands the chosen one over for the owner to write; each way out answers once

components.name: import_dialog
components.description: field mapping → `misc::ImportDialog`: a Select of the columns for each field, matched by name to start, over a preview of the first rows; Import asks for each required field's column

components.name: web_view
components.description: proven: `wry` 0.57 lays a child WKWebView over the window → `misc::WebView`, an address or the owner's HTML, following its box each frame and hidden out of view; it draws above gpui and ignores its clipping, and a press anywhere gpui draws, or the view leaving, hands the keyboard back. macOS only

components.name: print_button
components.description: blocked: gpui has no print API

components.name: a11y_checker
components.description: contrast audit → `tooling::A11yChecker`: each text color over its surfaces and each code color over the editor's at 4.5:1, the focus ring and chart hues beside the page at 3:1, failures first

components.name: screenshot_test_harness
components.description: self-capture; scripted input since T01 → `examples/gallery --capture`: every page light and dark, then its scripted states

components.name: render_surface
components.description: the host draws a frame at the box's size in device pixels; a new size or revision draws again; the old frame leaves the atlas

components.name: shader_view
components.description: `host`: the host renders on its own device and reads back into `rendering::RenderSurface`

components.name: zero_copy_texture
components.description: `blocked`: only macOS's Metal renderer draws `paint_surface`, NV12 alone

components.name: metal_surface
components.description: `blocked`: gpui shares no device; a host renders offscreen and feeds `rendering::RenderSurface`
